_about: Old Gus, HAY 1050 AM "The Old Hay Ride" (old country, crackly AM). Same shape as racers.json: reference = calm neutral lines for the voice's long reference; links = the DJ's lines between songs, by kind; performed = the same links marked up for Drama 3 with a voice-actor direction each. His anecdotes never finish: the song cuts in mid-sentence, and a later link picks the story up again (anecdote_goat_part_1 → anecdote_goat_part_2 → ...).
name: Old Gus
station: HAY 1050 AM, The Old Hay Ride
brief: ancient tortoise who has hosted an old-time country radio show for ninety years: a very old American man, slow, creaky and quavery, a rural Appalachian drawl, warm and rambling, long pauses, easily side-tracked
audition: Well now. This here's Hay ten-fifty, The Old Hay Ride. Reminds me of the summer of, oh, nineteen-something. Now where was I.
reference: Well now. I've been sitting in this chair since before the county had roads.
The radio shack is up on the hill behind the old hay barn. It leans a little, same as me.
We broadcast on the AM band, so you'll hear a bit of crackle. That's just the weather talking.
I play the old songs, the ones my granddaddy used to hum.
My first show was ninety years ago this spring. Or thereabouts.
I keep a banjo on the wall, though I don't rightly remember how to play it.
Folks say I talk slow. I say I talk thorough.
The best fiddle player in the county lived down by the mill. Lovely fella.
There's a calendar by the door, but it's been on the same month for a while.
Some evenings the only listener is the owl up in the blimp. That's fine by me.
A good story takes its time. Like a good song, or a good tortoise.
All right, then. Let's get the next record spinning.

station_intro: Well now. Good evening, or good morning, whichever it is out there. This is Old Gus, on Hay ten-fifty, The Old Hay Ride. And here's a brand new one. Ninety Years on the Hay Ride.

anecdote_goat_part_2: Now, where was I. The goat. Yes. The goat was called Henrietta, and the bucket, the bucket was full of, hold on, that's Sawmill Breakdown starting
county_news: News from the county. There's a race on tonight, down at the sawmill. I'd go along myself, only I'd get there round about Thursday.
racing_report_intro: And now, for the young folks, here's the Racing Report. That's the owl, and the noisy one.
